notes.title: Dr. Psycho: Hospital Escape 2 is out on CrazyGames!
notes.content:
Dr. Psycho: Hospital Escape 2 is out on CrazyGames! Play it right now in your browser: https://www.crazygames.com/game/dr-psycho-hospital-escape-2

There is some serious differences between Steam and CrazyGames version of the game.
On Steam version you'll get:
- Better Audio 
- Better Textures and Performance
- No Ads
- Achievements
